CORE PLATFORM
- Skillomate is an online learning platform for practical AI and digital-skill courses.
- Learners can browse published courses, open course details, watch video lessons, track lesson progress, save courses to a wishlist, download eligible learning content where supported, and receive certificates when course-completion rules are met.
- Nex AI is the in-app tutor. It helps learners understand Skillomate courses, selected video lessons, platform navigation, payments, subscriptions, profile/account settings, certificates, downloads, and study planning.
- Nex AI can make mistakes. Learners should verify important information.

ACCOUNT AND LOGIN
- Users sign up or log in with a mobile number and OTP.
- After sign-up, users complete profile details such as name, age, gender, avatar, and optional email.
- Profile photos are optional and use the system photo picker. Skillomate does not require broad photo-library access for standard profile setup.
- Users should keep OTPs, passwords, and device access private.
- Skillomate is intended for users aged 13 years and above.

COURSES AND ACCESS
- Published courses appear in the course catalog and course library.
- Course detail pages show course information, lesson lists, pricing/action buttons, and access state.
- After eligible payment or active subscription access, learners can watch protected lessons and use learning features.

Final ad kaise edit karein? Course mein CapCut tutorial nahi hai; final ad ka order: UGC hook → product videos → UGC → end card (price + order kaise karein). Text aur price editing mein daalo, AI se nahi.
Reviewed English translation: CapCut editing is not taught as a full tutorial in this course. The basic final-ad order is UGC hook → product videos → UGC → end card with the real price and how to order. Add text and price during editing, not with AI image generation.

[S4] AI Product Photoshoot & Ads — Chatbot Transcript — Ad plan (course-material) [Lesson 05; lesson_5]
• Ek hi chat mein: details + price + kahan bechte ho → 3 buyers, problems, angles. • Angle chuno → 5 hooks + 15-sec script + caption, "use only the features I gave you". • Flow ke 3 image prompts likhwao → Flow mein product sheet ke saath chalao. • Output padh ke jhoothe/unproven claims hatao.
Reviewed English translation: Provide real product details, price and where you sell. First ask for three buyer types, their problems and an ad angle for each. Choose one angle, then request 5 hooks, a 15-second script and an Instagram caption. Use only supplied features; add no unsupported claims. Next request 3 Google Flow image prompts and run them with the product sheet. Review and remove false or unproven claims.

[S5] AI Product Photoshoot & Ads — Chatbot Transcript — Course overview and prerequisites (course-material) [Lesson 01; lesson_1]
Naam: AI Product Photoshoot & Ads (Skillomate). Format: Hinglish, chhote video lessons, ek AI presenter. Lessons: 8. Example product: white 60% compact mechanical keyboard, red accent keys, price ₹2,599 (sirf example). Kiske liye: jo apna product online bechte hain, aur jo dusron ke liye product ads banana chahte hain. Zarurat: phone, laptop, koi bhi product.
Reviewed English translation: AI Product Photoshoot & Ads has 8 lessons: 01 Course Intro; 02 Phone Photo Se Studio Photo (phone photos, Product Sheet, white studio/lifestyle/dark premium); 03 Model Ke Saath Product (character and product references, model shots and hands); 04 Festive Shoot + Colour Variants (Diwali, wedding scenes and a sheet for each colour); 05 ChatGPT Se Ad Plan (buyers, problems, angles, hooks, script, caption and Flow prompts); 06 Photo Se Product Video (one movement with Ingredients); 07 UGC-Style Video (honest phone-style AI-presenter videos); 08 Finale (complete workflow, common mistakes, honesty and final project). You learn to create product photos, product videos and honest ads for your own products or clients. You need a phone, laptop and a product. Tools: Google Flow, ChatGPT and CapCut; a full CapCut editing tutorial is not taught. Course prompts are in lesson notes.

[S6] AI Product Photoshoot & Ads — Chatbot Transcript — L05 Step 3 Flow prompts (course-material) [Lesson 05; lesson_5]
Now write 3 image prompts for Google Flow (Nano Banana) for this ad. Each prompt must start with: "Use the uploaded product sheet as the reference. Keep the [product] exactly the same — same shape, same colour, same details, same text and logo, do not redesign it." Then describe one scene for the ad.
